agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The first full-HP Poké Ball escaped, consuming one ball and allowing one Mud-Slap; no verified crit-safe weakening or status action existed, so this was not an avoidable tactical error.
Catch RNG was the only material uncertainty; the second L-throw caught Croagunk without further weakening risk.
findings.observed_fact: Balls 12→11; Croagunk was caught to PC and named Croakatoa.

findings.summary: The 2% ROM encounter required 28 encounters and 261 movement steps; this is expected variance, but future rare-target hunts should retain the bounded cap.
findings.observed_fact: Target species 453 was found on Dewford Town land encounters at level 8.

correct_choices: Queried the ROM encounter table before hunting.
Used the bounded RAM-driven hunt and stopped at the exact species.
Passed the nickname Croakatoa into capture and verified placement in PC storage.
agent_review.next_test: When a future target has a verified crit-safe weakening or status move, confirm the helper uses it before throwing; otherwise keep this minimax-safe throw policy.
